## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
Describe the problem or pain point this feature would address.

## Proposed Solution
Describe your proposed solution or how you envision this feature working.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Cases
Provide specific use cases or examples of how this feature would be used.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Implementation Notes
(Optional) Any technical details or implementation suggestions.
